regressions.description: Incorrect expectation of KI-Stack-Cutover-Execute-v1.6.3.zip instead of the published -core.zip asset.
Historical full archive SHA256 must not be compared with the published runtime-core SHA256.
Do not require an embedded release manifest unless the real asset contract contains one.
PowerShell hashtable key enumeration must use .Keys, not .Key.
Do not build canonical path prefixes using a two-character backslash string.
Do not reject harmless .git exclusion strings through broad text matching.
Launchers must work from paths containing spaces and duplicated nested package directories.
Execute launchers that modify protected locations must self-elevate and preserve arguments and working directory.
Resolve PowerShell 7 robustly when pwsh.exe is not directly in PATH.
Preflight selection must use verified paths and deterministic recency/version rules.
Support documented manifest schemas and normalize versions without assuming optional fields.
A failed or unhandled self-test condition must reject the package.
Writes require backup, atomic completion and explicit partial-state handling.
Errors, exit codes and affected paths must be recorded in machine-readable reports.
Validation must run against the final delivered ZIP after fresh extraction, not only the build directory.
Reject traversal, absolute paths, ADS, device names, duplicates, case collisions and symlink entries.
Reject missing, unexpected and hash-drifted files relative to SHA256SUMS.txt.
The outer SHA256 sidecar must name and match the exact delivered ZIP.
Static lexical checks cannot replace the native PowerShell parser and AST for release approval.
Checks not actually executed must never be reported as passed.
Python unit tests must not create __pycache__ or .pyc files inside the delivered package before exact-manifest validation.

Strict current-package formatting, syntax-fixture and exact-set rules must not be retroactively imposed on immutable nested legacy archives without a validation contract; their paths, bytes and declared hashes remain mandatory.
A safe legacy nested archive without one wrapper directory must be extracted and validated at its archive root instead of being rejected or skipped.
